headline: Base Turnover Surges Across Multiple Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition the tempo of base exchanges has sharpened anew. Dead Lands, previously cooling, has flared with two fresh captures in the past two hours and a surge of Warden losses nearing 1,000 per hour, signalling a renewed contest for its eleven strategic points. Linn Mercy remains the most frenetic sector, logging four flips in the last two hours and twenty‑nine total today, pushing both sides’ casualty rates above 250 per hour and accelerating enlistments. Lykos Isle continues to churn, adding four captures in six hours and seven overall, with casualties still climbing on both sides. Fishermans Row, though quiet in the last two hours, retains a high daily turnover of nineteen events and heavy, if cooling, attrition. Endless Shore’s intense fighting has paused, recording no new flips since 09:20 yesterday, while Stlican Shelf shows modest but steady activity with six captures in the day. Meanwhile, rear‑area hexes such as Weathered Expanse and Clahstra exhibit sharply accelerating casualty curves without any territorial change, indicating deep attrition rather than front‑line movement.
